issues.on_page: Public works 263,365 (Street 230,086 + General Fund 33,279, which is the Cemetery department per p13/p17)
issues.issue: Statement Public works includes the Cemetery department 33,279, while detail records Cemetery spending as health/welfare; statement and detail functions disagree for that 33,279. Defensible as printed, flagged for consistency.
Cemetery department 'Rental and fees' is probably mostly cemetery lot/burial fees (Cemetery Fees); mixed label with no printed breakdown, kept as Rentals.
Page prints only 'Intergovernmental'; highway allocation is an assumption from the Street Fund (likely right, not printed).
Nature of the NPPD agreement receipt is not stated on the trimmed pages (could be a lease/service agreement payment); counted in Statement of Activities Charges for Services (p2), so defensible.
